feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: How Sen. Chris Van Hollen plans to flex Democratic power on the foreign aid front
entry.summary: The Maryland Democrat, who's the ranking member of the Senate Foreign Relations Subcommittee, just announced he's going to run for Majority Leader. He spoke to NPR about his foreign aid vision.

entry.title: Pedro Almodóvar explores how good friends can get so angry in 'Bitter Christmas'
entry.summary: In this film-within-a-film, Almodóvar explores how the closest pals can suddenly become bitterly estranged — and all the ways that art imitates life (and vice versa).

entry.title: Queens of the Stone Age try something new on 'Perfecth'
entry.summary: The rock band's ninth studio album features a wide range of new sonic directions.

entry.title: Manchester United names USMNT coach Mauricio Pochettino as its manager
entry.summary: Mauricio Pochettino is out as head coach of the U.S. men's national soccer team. Pochettino led the U.S. to the round of 16 at last year's World Cup. He's departing to coach Manchester United.

entry.title: Happy World Kindness Day! Check out our kind photos of kindness to humans -- and cats
entry.summary: Friday, November 13 is World Kindness Day. Your mission: Do something kind. Small acts of kindness definitely count!

entry.title: Kratom and 7-OH can feel like 'a miracle.' They can also be addictive
entry.summary: In the last decade, strong support for kratom and 7-OH products have kept them federally legal. That's started to change. A crackdown for some highly potent products related to kratom is coming.

entry.title: Hegseth awards medal to soldier who chastised him
entry.summary:
Pete Hegseth was yelled at by a sentinel for poor decorum at Arlington National Cemetery. Now the Secretary of Defense has
given him a medal.

entry.title: Rivers in the sky are raining down on the Pacific Northwest. What are they?
entry.summary: Atmospheric rivers are large bands of water vapor in the sky. They are dumping trillions of gallons of water on Washington and Oregon, just as high tides and winds batter shorelines.

entry.title: Why is Google cutting off Search from AI-free schools? Here are some theories
entry.summary: The forthcoming move has left some parents and educators frustrated and wondering about the company's motivations.

entry.title: These swing voters have low expectations for divided government
entry.summary: Key voters in North Carolina are pessimistic the blue wave flipping control of Congress will solve their economic woes. Many say President Trump will be the chief obstacle.
